description: The owner's answer to one card, written ONLY by AAC and signed. An unsigned or mis-signed file is not an answer.

answerId.description: Stable AAC answer record UUID for receiver deduplication; absent in legacy answers.

cardSha256.description: Hex SHA-256 of the card file answered.

choice.description: Chosen option keys. Empty or omitted when the record carries only a note.

kind.description: Answer kind: answer closes the card, note and object leave it open, done closes an action card.

note.description: The owner's words, verbatim, if any.

signature.description: Ed25519 signature over the canonical JSON (RFC 8785 style) of this answer with signature removed.

keyId.description: Signing key id; verifiers try keys/<keyId>.pub first.

value.description: Standard base64 of the 64-byte Ed25519 signature.
